name: Restaurant Franchise Owner Assistant
tagline: The morning desk for a multi-store restaurant owner: decisions, taxes, numbers.
description: For an owner running several restaurant locations. Each morning it rounds up messages waiting on a call - bank notices, supplier updates, payroll items - into one digest. Monthly it works through delivery-platform sales tax per store and turns point-of-sale figures into side-by-side reports.
author: kheladi
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
